event_name: Document 45 Date 23 October 2022 Time 15:36 2022 UNITED STATES GRAND PRIX 20 - 23 October 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 10 fell more than 10 car lengths behind during the Safety Car period.
offence: Breach of Article 55.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and car positioning evidence. It was clear from the evidence that car 10 was significantly more than 10 car lengths behind the car in front.
rules_referenced: Article 55.7 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 10 Distance Behind The Safety Car
